summary.text: Tim Schaffer is serving his fourth term in the Ohio Senate for District 20, which encompasses Fairfield and Licking counties and portions of Perry County. He chairs the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Schaffer was first elected to the Ohio House in 2000, and after three terms was elected to the Ohio Senate in the 31st district; he returned to the House in 2015.
In the House he chaired Ways & Means and previously chaired the Public Utilities and Commerce & Labor committees.
Schaffer graduated from Lancaster High School, attended Ohio University-Lancaster, and earned a Bachelor's degree in Political Science and Communications from Mount Union College.
He has a private sector career as an association executive and has served as chairman of the Fairfield County Republican Party.
